parameters.content:
## Lead Qualification Agent
Score every inbound lead on budget, authority, need and timing, then route it before it goes cold.

A hosted n8n form collects enquiries. Each lead is scored on budget, authority, need and timeline (0-100). Hot leads ping you on Slack immediately and get a call offer by email; warm and cold leads get the right first reply. Every lead is logged.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/lead-qualification-agent
